title: skills-sh-jezweb-claude-skills-claude-agent-sdk
summary: # Changelog ## 0.3.322 - Updated to parity with Claude Code v2.1.322 ## 0.3.321 - Fixed `canUseTool` getting the app's own PreToolUse hook reason in `decisionReason` when another hook also asked - Fixed a PreToolUse hook's `ask` being lost when another hook's `defer` finished first and could not be honored - Fixed every hook being dropped when one event in the `hooks` option is set to `undefined` - Fixed `WarmQuery.query()` with a string prompt hanging after `startup()` with `resume` when the resumed session finished a turn of its own before the prompt was sent - Fixed `setMcpServers` closing a folder's `.mcp.json` or local-scope MCP server when passed an in-process server of the same name, in sessions bound with `SpareProcess.claim()` - Fixed `reloadSkills()`, `reloadPlugins()` and `system/init` dropping project skills, commands or agents that a worktree lacks after Claude entered it
type: skills
tags: skills-sh, skills-sh-all-time
source_url: https://raw.githubusercontent.com/anthropics/claude-agent-sdk-typescript/main/CHANGELOG.md
